most_similar_reason: Candidate 10 matches the target most closely because divine beings are deliberately sent by the gods to civilize a needy humanity, teaching crafts and arts, founding a great city (with a temple at its center) and standing at the head of a line of primeval kings, exactly the culture-bringer-plus-founding-king pattern of the seven sages.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 1 is least similar because it is a purely martial hero biography of monster-slaying, resurrection and chained punishment, with no civilizing sages, no teaching of arts, no flood, no founded cities, and no fish- or bird-hybrid wisdom figures.
